name: eToro
description: eToro is a social investing and trading platform for stocks, ETFs, cryptoassets, commodities, currencies, indices, portfolios, and community features. Its Public API supports market data, portfolio and balance information, watchlists, social feeds, notifications, and authorized demo or real trading operations for eligible verified users.
agentUseSummary: Add an eligible user's eToro public API key and exact Demo or Real user key, then let agents read bounded market and portfolio data or use the full authorized API under Safe or Dangerously skip permissions.

credentialRequirements.name: ETORO_PUBLIC_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: eToro public API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: The application-identifying public API key available to the verified eToro API user, stored encrypted by Railway.

credentialRequirements.name: ETORO_USER_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: eToro user key
credentialRequirements.helpText: The exact Demo or Real, Read or Write user key generated by the customer, stored encrypted by Railway.

capabilities.label: Read market and portfolio data
capabilities.description: Read bounded balances, portfolios, positions, watchlists, market data, rankings, user statistics, feeds, and other authorized resources.

capabilities.label: Full eToro Public API
capabilities.description: Use the complete documented API surface authorized by the exact user key, including trading and social mutations.

allowed.label: Read eToro data
allowed.description: Read one bounded documented eToro resource.

approvalRequired.label: Use full eToro API
approvalRequired.description: Use a documented trade, transfer, withdrawal, portfolio, watchlist, alert, feed, or other mutation; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded reads run directly; trading, transfers, withdrawals, posts, alerts, watchlist changes, and other mutations require approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Every selected eToro operation authorized by the exact user key runs without Relay per-action approval; account and environment binding, key permissions, market rules, provider limits, secret isolation, request bounds, and audits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts typed eToro wrappers and attaches encrypted keys plus a fresh request UUID only to the fixed Public API origin.
Relay mounts typed eToro wrappers and attaches encrypted keys plus a fresh request UUID only to the fixed Public API origin.

providerSetup.blocker: API access requires an eligible verified eToro account. The user must generate an environment-specific Read or Write key and complete eToro's identity verification, SMS/phone verification, regional eligibility, and any early-access requirements.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the provider-console task, use an eligible verified user to generate restricted Demo and, if approved, Real keys, then validate key permissions, bounded reads, Safe approval, one Dangerous demo trade, revocation, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: eToro documents its Public API for real-time market data, portfolios, orders, social features, watchlists, feeds, and trading workflows.

eToro documents the required public API key, user key, UUID request header, fixed API base, verified-account requirement, Demo or Real environment selection, Read or Write permissions, IP allowlisting, expiry, and phone verification.
eToro describes its developer APIs as early access for selected users and an upcoming application ecosystem, making live eligibility an external provider blocker.
